task_description: The attached code trains and evaluates the FunkSVD algorithm with stochastic gradient descent for recommender systems. Your goal is to find novel ways to optimize energy efficiency.

Name: adaptive_learning_rates
Title: Adaptive Learning Rates for Stochastic Gradient Descent
Experiment: Investigate how adaptive learning rates (e.g., Adam, RMSprop) can reduce the training time and energy usage of SGD-based recommender systems.

Name: e_fold_cv
Title: E-Fold Cross-Validation for Model Performance Estimation
Experiment: Develop an alternative to k-fold cross-validation named e-fold cross-validation. Instead of a static k it uses an intelligently chosen or dynamically adjusted parameter e to optimize the number of folds and to minimize computational energy while maintaining reliable model performance estimates.
